     a. Check if the indices of the integers a, a+1, ..., a+k-1 form a "good index sequence."

fix_code:
n, k = map(int, input().split())
p = list(map(int, input().split()))
idx = [0] * (n + 1)
for i in range(n):
    idx[p[i]] = i
ans = float('inf')
for a in range(1, n - k + 2):
    indices = [idx[a + j] for j in range(k)]
    max_idx = max(indices)
    min_idx = min(indices)
    ans = min(ans, max_idx - min_idx)
print(ans)
